# Deploy ownCloud by Kiteworks

> Supplemental, non-standard discovery file generated from the same policy sources as the HTML and Markdown documentation. It is not an API or a substitute for the official documentation.

## Overview

Deploy ownCloud by Kiteworks is a one-page deployment hub that generates target-neutral ownCloud Infinite Scale profiles and renders them for Docker Compose, Podman Compose, Helm, and Argo CD. All generation happens locally in the browser or CLI; no profile data or secrets are transmitted.

## Deployment constraints

- Embedded IDP/IDM is allowed for no more than 20 users. Above 20, external OIDC plus a trusted LDAPS directory is required.
- Collabora is the only office integration.
- Storage is standard `ocis` on POSIX, or `s3ng` with POSIX metadata.
- NFS must be effectively verified as NFSv4.2.
- PosixFS, xattr, GPFS-specific modes and experimental/unsupported features are denied.

## Version Pinning

| Component | Pinned Version | Maturity |
| --- | --- | --- |
| oCIS (Docker/Podman) | 8.2.0 | Production-gated |
| oCIS (Kubernetes) | 7.1.4 | Community Preview |
| Helm chart | 0.7.0 | Community Preview |
| Collabora | Latest stable | Production-ready |

Pins are recorded in `catalog/sources.lock.json` and `catalog/compatibility.json`. The generator rejects any profile that would select a non-pinned or incompatible version. Automated discovery records upstream drift but never auto-updates pins.

## EULA

Runnable output requires explicit acknowledgement of the pinned ownCloud Infinite Scale EULA, including Section 6 (No warranties) and Section 7 (Limitation of liability). Browser acceptance is local. CLI acceptance is recorded in a local audit file and is not transmitted.

## Support and maturity

| Maturity Level | Visibility | Runnable | Production Claim |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Experimental | No; catalogue metadata only | Never | Never |
| Community Preview | Yes with persistent warning | Evaluation/tested combinations only | No |
| Production | Yes | Yes after all gates | Only with named owner approval |

- Kubernetes/Helm and Argo CD are runnable Community Preview outputs held at chart 0.7.0 / oCIS 7.1.4 under open issue #6. They are not presented as oCIS 8.2 or production.
- K3s is explicitly EVALUATION-ONLY and Part 1 refuses to install it while issue #6 is open.

## Deployment Families

| Family | Native Deployment | Management Wrapper | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Single host | Docker Compose | Ansible | Production (Docker), Community Preview (Podman) |
| Single host | Podman Compose | Ansible | Community Preview |
| Kubernetes | Helm | Argo CD | Community Preview |

## Security Requirements

- TLS is mandatory for production; self-signed certificates are evaluation-only
- NFS must negotiate v4.2 or higher
- All generated secrets are local and never transmitted
- EULA acknowledgement is mandatory for runnable output
- Unknown maturity levels, storage drivers, or renderer values are denied by default

## Platform Support

| Platform | Docker | Podman | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ubuntu 22.04 LTS | Full | Full (rootless) | Production |
| Ubuntu 24.04 LTS | Full | Full (rootless) | Production |
| Debian 12 | Full | Full (rootless) | Production |
| RHEL 9 | Full | Full (rootful) | Community Preview |
| Rocky Linux 9 | Full | Full (rootful) | Community Preview |
| AlmaLinux 9 | Full | Full (rootful) | Community Preview |
| CentOS Stream 9 | Full | Full (rootful) | Community Preview |
